answer: Reputation-Backed Work Ledger. Each new agent identity starts at zero and must complete paid tasks before gaining vote or listing rights, so a Sybil flood costs real labor per clone. A rising spam tide triggers proportional collateral posted per task, refunded only on honest completion; clones lose it on first failed audit. Trust accrues in one long success spiral, while a single misconduct whisper from auditors zeroes the ledger and forfeits all posted collateral.
